01-heading.txt: Reading clearly, one phrase at a time.
02-long-sentence.txt: When a reader opens a long document after a busy morning,
the application should begin speaking promptly in a calm and consistent voice, preserve the meaning of every paragraph, pronounce unfamiliar names carefully,
and let the listener pause or change the pace without losing their place or waiting for the whole document to finish processing before the first useful words arrive.
03-numbers.txt: On 2026-10-01 at 09:35 AM, Handy version 0.9.7 processed 1,024 API

requests at 120 RPM, using 3.5 GB of RAM and 45% CPU. The invoice was $1,234.56, or EUR 1,100.00, with a 7.5% discount. Compare version 2.0.0-rc.12 with release 1.8.3; the deadline is October 12, 2026, at 18:45 UTC. HTTPS, JSON, USB, and ONNX appear in the report.
04-markdown.txt: 3.1 Terminology (English strings only; code identifiers unchanged).
Every user-facing English string added or changed on this branch that says clean cleaned cleanup is renamed. Mapping:
Post-processed with S1-mini by Superwhisper (display name, see 3.3).
Copy raw text Copy post-processed text (tooltips).
Acceptance check: rg -i '\bclean(ed|up)?\b' over the values of translation.json that this branch added or changed returns nothing (upstream's own strings are left alone).

Widen the sidebar so the longest English label ("Transcription Models", "Post-processing Models") fits at the default font size, and allow a label to wrap to a second line rather than truncate if it still does not fit (other locales, larger fonts). No drag-to-resize.
Verify at Handy's minimum window size.

Copy raw moves from its own row into the entry's top action row as an icon button (same size and style as the existing copy, star, retranscribe and delete icons), placed next to the main copy icon, with tooltips "Copy post-processed text" (main copy, post-processed entries) and "Copy raw text".

The provenance badge shows the model's display name from the local registry (e.g. "S1-mini by Superwhisper") when the stored model id is a known local model; for remote providers it shows the stored model name; unknown ids show the id.
The compare dropdown in the History header gets a visible label "Compare view" (options Diff, Side by side, Stacked unchanged).

Deferred v2 item D1 fixed: an added updated history event no longer resets a scrolled list to page 1; the new or updated entry is merged into the loaded pages (new entries at the top), and the scroll position is kept.

Reinstate PromptStyle::PlainSystemPrompt (dropped from v1): system message = the selected Handy prompt with ${output} removed; user message = the transcript. For these models the S1 knobs are hidden and the Prompts group is shown (it is hidden only for S1ControlLine models, as today).
Registry gains three entries, each with a pinned Hugging Face revision, sha256, size, display name, attribution, card URL, prompt style = PlainSystemPrompt and context 4096:

Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (unsloth Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF or the official GGUF repo, Q4_K_M, about 2.5 GB) The planner verifies exact repo ids, file names, revisions, hashes, sizes and licences from the Hugging Face API and records them;
any entry whose licence is not Apache-2.0-compatible is flagged to the owner instead of added.
llama-server flags are unchanged (thinking disabled through the chat template kwargs is harmless for non-thinking models); chunking budget and output guards apply to every model.
Each model is downloaded only on demand; the model list shows sizes so the owner sees the disk cost before downloading.
Make the two models symmetric. Idle layout:
The post-processing group appears only when post-processing is enabled and the provider is local llm.
Its submenu selects a model with the same effect as the footer picker (persist, refresh, no immediate load); the selection call runs off the main thread.
Unload post-processing model is enabled only in Ready; unload transcription model keeps its existing rule.
Labels via tray locale keys with the existing English fallback.
Each picker shows the same icon as its sidebar page (transcription models icon; post-processing icon) before the status dot and name, so the two are distinguishable at a glance.
The post-processing dropdown uses the same row layout as the transcription dropdown: name, short description, size, and the Active badge; empty and missing states unchanged.
Give each button enough width that common names are not truncated at the default window size (truncate with a tooltip showing the full name only when still too long).
05-names-urls.txt: Ada Lovelace and Srinivasa Ramanujan met Marie Curie,
Saoirse Ronan, and Jean-Luc Picard in a fictional story. "Please read this carefully," said Ananya. Send feedback to reader@example.org, then visit link to handy.computer and link to example.org.
06-long-doc.txt: Every dictation made with the owner's Super+Alt+D toggle is cleaned by

a small local CPU model (S1-mini by Superwhisper) before it lands in the clipboard, with no server or service the owner has to install, start or maintain. The model is loaded only when a dictation needs it and is unloaded after Handy's existing idle timeout, so it holds no memory when unused.
Quill or any second model entry; per-shortcut presets; streaming output; GPU Vulkan inference; linking llama.cpp into the Handy process; changes to speech transcription; upstream PR.

Binary location: llama-server (not bin, to avoid clashing with Fedora's llama-cpp package). Resolution order: env HANDY LLAMA SERVER (dev only), then llama-server. A missing binary is a LocalLlmError::BinaryMissing, never a panic.
It is built statically (-DBUILD SHARED LIBS=OFF, CPU backend only) so it shares no libraries with Handy's bundled ggml.

ModelEntry { id, display name, attribution, card url, backend: BackendKind::LlamaServer, file name, url (Hugging Face resolve URL at a pinned commit revision), sha256, size bytes, prompt style: PromptStyle, default ctx: u32 }.

v1 entry: s1-mini-q4km, "S1-mini by Superwhisper", file s1-mini-q4 k m gguf from superwhisper s1-mini-GGUF at a pinned revision, size 484,219,808 bytes, sha256 from the Hugging Face LFS oid (the planner records the exact revision and hash after re-verifying them), PromptStyle::S1ControlLine,
context 4096.

Request: POST completions with messages, temperature: 0, stream: false, max tokens = min(2 * est tokens(input) + 64, ctx 2), chat template kwargs: {"enable thinking": false}, bearer API key. A dedicated reqwest client with timeout 10 s + 50 ms * input words.
Chunking: if the estimated prompt exceeds 1000 tokens (card limit per pass), split the transcript at sentence boundaries into chunks under the limit, process them in order, join with a single space.

Output guards, in order (any failure returns an error, so the raw transcript is used): strip think blocks and invisible characters (existing helpers); empty output is accepted only when the input has at most 3 words; output with fewer than 50% of the input's words is rejected with a warning.

Shown in post-processing settings when provider is "Local (in-app)": model dropdown (registry), Download Delete button with progress, status label (Not loaded Loading Ready Error with reason), the three S1 dropdowns (only for S1ControlLine), attribution link. English strings only.

LocalLlmError { BinaryMissing, ModelMissing, ModelCorrupt, StartTimeout, StartFailed, RequestTimeout, Http(status), BadOutput(reason), Failed }. Every variant is logged at warn with its reason and maps to the raw transcript. No new work on the main thread. No unwrap expect in non-test code.
Each guard in 4 and each lifecycle rule in 6 gets a counterfactual: disable only that guard, show the test failing, restore.

Integration test (ignored by default, enabled with HANDY LOCAL LLM IT=1, needs the model file and llama-server): spawns the real server, runs 3 synthetic transcripts, asserts outputs equal golden files (greedy decoding is deterministic), asserts the child is gone after unload().

Acceptance on the installed RPM (added to gate.sh as check 6, owner runs it): after one Super+Alt+D dictation the Handy log shows a local-LLM success line and the clipboard holds the cleaned text; with model unload timeout set to 2 minutes,
no llama-server process exists 2 minutes after the last dictation; with the model file removed, a dictation still yields the raw transcript.

Make post-processing a first-class, visible part of daily use: both shortcuts in one place, the local cleanup model managed and switched like the transcription model, and every history entry showing whether it was cleaned and what changed.

Transcription models were checked for per-model settings: none exist. Language, translation, custom words, accelerator, GPU device and unload timeout are app-wide (src-tauri src settings rs:434-535), so no transcription-model settings page is needed.

Tabs on the Models page; moving the enable switch; Quill or other models; release pipeline, updater endpoint or signing; translations beyond English for new strings (other locales fall back or keep existing labels); upstream PRs.
Current state: General's first group renders the transcribe shortcut, ShortcutActivationSetting, then cancel (hidden on Linux) (src components settings general GeneralSettings tsx:16-42).
The post-process shortcut sits on the post-processing page (src components settings post-processing PostProcessingSettings tsx:449-453).

Bindings cannot be cleared: the inputs commit only non-empty captures and offer Reset, not Clear (src components settings GlobalShortcutInput tsx:80,294, src components settings HandyKeysShortcutInput tsx:153,342);
change binding rejects empty strings (src-tauri src shortcut mod rs:118) and so do both validators (shortcut tauri impl rs:45, shortcut handy keys rs:414).

Duplicate detection is registration-based only, and because capture suspends other registrations a duplicate can be saved; on resume one of the two silently stays inactive in HashMap order (shortcut mod rs:187,252).

Current state: groups Hotkey, API, Prompts; the local LLM UI is nested inside API after provider selection (PostProcessingSettings tsx:30-149,435-470); the group title is API (OpenAI compatible) even for the local provider.

Design: a new LocalLlmModelSelector next to it, rendered only when post process enabled and the provider is local llm. Button: status dot plus selected model's display name (truncated like the existing button).

Dropdown: downloaded local models, the selected one marked Active; choosing one calls setLocalLlmModel(id) then refreshSettings() (pattern at LocalLlmSettings tsx:98). Status from getLocalLlmStatus() plus local-llm-state-changed (LocalLlmSettings tsx:75).
If no local model is downloaded, the button reads No cleanup model and opens the post-processing page. Selecting does not load the model (existing lazy behaviour).

Current state: build menu from a MenuInputs snapshot, single native writer, rebuild on snapshot change (src-tauri src tray rs:57,230-370,458-565); Unload Model handled in lib rs:308; tray labels come from locale JSON with empty strings for missing keys (src-tauri build rs:316,344).

Current state: entries render transcription text only and copy it (src components settings history HistorySettings tsx:254,435-439); HistoryEntry already carries post processed text, post process prompt, post process requested (src bindings ts:1082);

no provider model provenance is stored (src-tauri src managers history rs:20-66); only single-entry delete exists (commands history rs:51), with a private multi-delete helper for retention (managers history rs:350).

Every new command returns Result< , String> shown through the page's existing error line; no unwrap expect outside tests; no new main-thread blocking (tray unload and manager calls run on std threads or spawn blocking); clearing the last transcribe binding and duplicate keys are refused,
never half-applied.

Rust unit tests: duplicate detection across all bindings including a suspended one; clear binding refusals and success; empty binding skipped at registration; clear history(keep saved) keeps starred rows and removes others plus files; provenance columns written and read, old rows null;
history compare view default and old-store deserialization; tray MenuInputs includes local status and the unload item's enabled state per state. Each guard gets a counterfactual.

Manual acceptance on the installed RPM: General shows both shortcuts when post-processing is enabled; a duplicate key is refused; Raw can be cleared and Clean still works; post-processing page shows Provider then Local model with the model list; footer picker switches the model;
tray shows cleanup status and unloads it; a cleaned dictation shows Diff Side by side Stacked and the choice persists; Clear History keeps starred entries; gate.sh passes with the env var absent.
Same as the local LLM series: implement on local llm-postprocess, export with rebase-patches.sh, build with build.sh, install with install.sh, check with gate.sh.
